excerpt.zh: [FromFrom.GetName]落入了贝塔变种手中。他们要求立刻转移一部分他们的子个体，同时在我们的星球建立子意识以确保他们的知识和存在能够续存。
excerpt.en: [FromFrom.GetName] has fallen to our Beta variants. They are now demanding the immediate transferal of some of their drones as well as the establishment of a sub-consciousness on our world to ensure the survival of their knowledge and existence.
